claims.text: 事实：Alphabet 的最重要业务仍是 Google，且 2025 年收入最大来源是 Google advertising；Google Cloud 已成为第二大且增长更快的分部，但规模仍明显小于广告主业。按已披露收入规模看，未来 3–5 年的第一优先级增长驱动仍应是搜索/YouTube/广告体系的再增长，其次是云业务扩张。

citations.quote: Alphabet is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google. claims.text: 推断：最重要的中期增长催化剂是 AI 对搜索与云的货币化升级。披露显示公司认为 AI 产品与服务会继续带来收入，且已把 AI Overviews、AI Mode 和 Google Cloud 的企业 AI 方案作为货币化方向。若这些新形态的变现速度和单次查询/客户的收入强度提升，Alphabet 的价值上行空间会高于仅靠传统广告自然增长的情形。

Certain of these revenues have been growing at a rate higher than our advertising revenues, becoming a larger percentage of our consolidated revenues, and we expect this trend to continue. The margins on these revenues vary significantly and are generally lower than the margins on our advertising revenues.

claims.text: 事实/推断：AI 基础设施是最重要的投入项之一，同时也是主要下行风险之一。公司明确预计 2026 年技术基础设施投资将较 2025 年“显著增加”，而 2025 年资本开支已达 914 亿美元；若投入持续抬升但收入变现滞后，利润率和自由现金流会承压，从而压低估值。

citations.quote: Increased Investment in Technical Infrastructure: We continue to invest in capital expenditures as we scale our technical infrastructure, in particular for AI, to meet the demand of our users and enterprise customers and to support research internally. We invested heavily in capital expenditures in 2025 and in 2026, we expect to significantly increase, relative to 2025, our investment in our technical infrastructure, including servers and network equipment, and data centers. The costs associated with operating our technical infrastructure - depreciation, energy, equipment, and network capacity - are expected to significantly increase as developing and serving AI offerings require more compute power than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings. While our technical infrastructure costs increase, we expect to continue to drive efficiencies in our data centers, for example, through the design of our AI models and our TPU and GPU-based technical infrastructure.
•Capital expenditures, which primarily reflected investments in technical infrastructure, were $91.4 billion for the year ended December 31, 2025.

claims.text: 事实：下行风险的核心仍是广告业务，尤其是搜索广告。公司披露 2025 年超过 70% 的总收入来自在线广告，并明确警示：AI 正在重塑广告行业、政策与隐私规则变化、广告屏蔽技术、以及宏观放缓都可能损害业务。若广告主 ROI 下降或流量迁移，Alphabet 的现金流和估值会首先受冲击。

citations.quote: We generate a significant portion of our revenues from advertising. Reduced spending by advertisers, a loss of partners, shifts in online advertising, new and evolving advertising formats, or new or existing technologies that block ads online or affect our ability to personalize ads could harm our business.

We generated more than 70% of total revenues from online advertising in 2025. Many of our advertisers, companies that distribute our products and services, digital publishers, and content providers can terminate their contracts with us at any time. These partners may not continue to do business with us if we do not create more value (such as increased numbers of users or customers, new sales leads, increased brand awareness, or more effective monetization) than their available alternatives.

We believe AI is quickly reshaping the advertising industry, including how ads are delivered online, and we and our competitors are constantly adjusting to meet this shift and provide new and evolving advertising formats. There is no assurance that we will adapt effectively and competitively to meet this shift, and that such advertising formats, strategies, and offerings will be successful.

Changes to our advertising policies and data privacy practices, as well as changes to other companies' advertising or data privacy practices have in the past, and may in the future, affect the advertising services that we are able to provide. In addition, technologies have been developed that make personalized ads more difficult, or that block the display of ads altogether, and some providers of online services have integrated technologies that could impair the availability and functionality of third-party digital advertising. Failing to provide superior value or deliver advertisements effectively and competitively could harm our business, reputation, financial condition, and operating results.

Expenditures by advertisers tend to correlate with overall economic conditions. Adverse macroeconomic conditions have affected, and may in the future affect, the demand for advertising, resulting in fluctuations in the amounts our advertisers spend on advertising, which could harm our financial condition and operating results.

claims.text: 事实/推断：Cloud 安全与数据中心相关并购、以及 Waymo 等 Other Bets 的进展，属于次级上行来源而非主驱动。Wiz 和 Intersect 的收购说明公司在云安全与基础设施侧继续加码；Waymo 已有大额外部融资并在多城提供付费自动驾驶服务，但 Other Bets 2025 年仍录得 75 亿美元经营亏损。对股价而言，这些业务更多体现“期权价值”，只有当其规模化收入能覆盖投入时才会显著重估。

limitations: 材料主要是 2025 年年报和 2026 年三季度前后披露；没有市场预期、估值倍数、分部利润的完整最新明细，因此不能判断短期股价涨跌幅。
部分判断属于基于管理层表述的条件性推断，不是公司已明确披露的结论。
未获得更细的分部利润/客户留存/AI 产品商业化转化率数据，因此无法精确排序云与广告在利润贡献上的先后，只能依据收入规模、管理层表述和风险提示做优先级判断。
findings: 优先级判断：1) AI 驱动的搜索与广告再货币化；2) Google Cloud 的企业 AI 与基础设施扩张；3) 订阅/设备等非广告收入扩张；4) Other Bets 的期权价值（Waymo 等）。
最重要的下行风险：广告业务被 AI、隐私/政策变化、宏观放缓和广告屏蔽工具共同冲击；其次是 AI 基础设施投入过快导致利润率与自由现金流承压。
对股价最关键的判断不是“AI 是否重要”，而是 AI 是否能在维持或改善利润率的前提下扩大收入；这一点目前材料只能部分支持，不能直接推出估值方向。
需要追踪的验证指标：广告收入增速与占比、Google Cloud 增速、资本开支与折旧、TAC rate、利润率、以及 Waymo/Other Bets 是否从亏损走向可规模化收入。
answer.stop_reason: 已读取年报与MD&A关键段落并完成优先级判断；缺少市场预期与更细利润数据，无法量化股价幅度。
